citation.locator: Item 5.03 and referenced effectiveness of split on 2024-06-07
citation.verbatim: The Amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on June 7, 2024. Exhibit 3.1: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Process the mandatory 10-for-1 NVDA stock split for MEGA using the 2024-06-06 record-date position, confirm the post-split position of 180,000 shares as of 2024-06-07, and disseminate the PCF with 1,800 NVDA shares per creation unit on 2024-06-10. No election, cash booking, or escalation is required for this split episode.

actions.action: update PCF NVDA quantity per creation unit to 1,800
